description: Use this when the user is travelling abroad and wants mobile data, an eSIM, a travel SIM, or to avoid roaming charges. Finds eSIM plans in the OsmO catalogue that cover the whole trip, including multi-country trips, and ranks them by the published rule: fit first, then total price. Trip length is required. Covers data plans from the providers listed in the result. Does not handle home-country phone contracts or purchases.

dataGb.description: Data needed per person in GB; omit to estimate from usage

travellers.description: People travelling; each needs their own eSIM

days.description: Days in this destination (give for every leg, or not at all)

destination.description: Country, territory, city or region, e.g. 'Japan', 'Bali', 'Europe'

usage.description: Phone use if dataGb is unknown: light (~0.3 GB/day), moderate (~0.8), heavy (~2)

name: search_esim_plans
title: Search eSIM plans
